name: NORDIC denoising (Python)
desc: NORDIC (NOise reduction with DIstribution Corrected PCA): locally low-rank denoising of complex (magnitude + phase) fMRI/dMRI data. Python translation of the MATLAB NORDIC_Raw. For full documentation see https://github.com/JimJam07/NORDIC-python and https://github.com/SteenMoeller/NORDIC_Raw.
